tools.description: Only to replace an existing link or token: returns a one-time link_url (10 min) where the user enters a new personal access token. Give the user exactly that URL — never build one or send them to the API. No arguments.
tools.name: pm_link_account

tools.description: Call only after a tool answered action_required=link_account, or when the user asks which account is linked. Not linked: give the user exactly the returned link_url (they enter their access token there, never in the chat). No arguments.
tools.name: pm_link_status

tools.description: Remove the user's linked OpenProject personal access token. No arguments.
tools.name: pm_unlink_account

tools.description: List valid statuses, types, priorities and time-entry activities (kind, default all). Names are also matched partially, so look up only when unsure.

kind.description: Which reference list to return. Defaults to all four.

tools.name: pm_list_reference_data

tools.description: Find people by name/email (query) or list a project's members (project). Assignee fields also accept a name or "me" directly.

project.description: Project identifier (e.g. "AIS"), name or numeric id to list that project's members; a key like "AIS-499" names its project.

query.description: Free-text match against name or email.

tools.name: pm_list_users

tools.description: List/search visible OpenProject projects. Optional: search (matches name or identifier).

search.description: Free-text match against project name or identifier.

tools.name: pm_list_projects

tools.description: Get one project's summary; include_members adds who is on it. Required: project.

include_members.description: When true, also return the project's members and their roles.

project.description: Project identifier (e.g. "AIS"), name or numeric id; a key like "AIS-499" names its project.

tools.name: pm_get_project

tools.description: List or search work packages (free-text query and/or filters, all optional). A query that is a key ("AIS-499") or id also returns that work package as exact_match. Date filters created_/updated_/due_ + on (exact day), from, to (inclusive). Rows carry `key` (name work packages by it, pass it to other tools) and the main fields; select ["*"] returns all.

group_by.description: Field to group results by, e.g. "status": adds groups [{value, count}] over the whole result.

limit.description: Max results per page (default 50, hard ceiling 200).

open_only.description: Only open work packages: status neither is_closed nor is_done ("Done" counts as finished). An explicit status still applies.

project.description: Project identifier (e.g. "AIS"), name or numeric id to scope results to; a key like "AIS-499" names its project.

query.description: Free text, or a key/id for exact_match.

select.description: Fields per row; ["*"] = all (adds id, author, responsible, created_at, updated_at).

status.description: Status name or id, or "open"/"closed" (as in open_only).

type.description: Work package type name (case-insensitive) or id.

tools.name: pm_list_work_packages

tools.description: DEPRECATED — use pm_list_work_packages(query=…), which takes the same arguments.
tools.name: pm_search_work_packages

tools.description: Get one work package by key (e.g. "AIS-469") or numeric id, including its description. Required: id. Optional: text_limit.

id.description: Work package key (e.g. "AIS-469") or numeric id (e.g. 17806).

text_limit.description: Truncate the description to this many characters (default 6000, 0 = full).

tools.name: pm_get_work_package

tools.description: Create a work package. Required: project, type (name or id), subject. assignee: id, login or "me"; parent: key or id; date: milestones; estimated_time: ISO-8601 (e.g. "PT8H"). Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. A milestone (e.g. weekly goal) cannot be a parent — pass it in relates_to instead.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; the single date of a milestone type.

parent.description: Parent work package key (e.g. "AIS-8") or numeric id.

project.description: Project identifier (e.g. "AIS"), name or numeric id; a key like "AIS-499" names its project.

relates_to.description: Keys to link with a relates relation right away (e.g. the weekly goal).

items.description: Work package key (e.g. "AIS-469") or numeric id (e.g. 17806).

tools.name: pm_create_work_package

tools.description: Update a work package's fields. Required: id (or ids for several) plus one field; lock_version is fetched if omitted. Milestones (e.g. weekly goals) have one date: set date. Unapplied fields come back in warnings; a status change returns next_statuses. If the workflow forbids a direct status change, the answer has updated=false, allowed_next and usually retry — pass retry as the next call's arguments.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; the single date of a milestone type.

id.description: Work package key (e.g. "AIS-469") or numeric id (e.g. 17806).

ids.description: Instead of id: apply the same change to these (max 25).

items.description: Work package key (e.g. "AIS-469") or numeric id (e.g. 17806).

status_path.description: Statuses to walk in order, last = target, e.g. ["In Review","Closed"]; every hop is saved, other fields go with the first. Max 4.

tools.name: pm_update_work_package

tools.description: Add a comment to a work package. Required: id, comment. Optional: notify (bool, default false).

id.description: Work package key (e.g. "AIS-469") or numeric id (e.g. 17806).

tools.name: pm_comment_work_package

tools.description: A work package's comment/activity log, oldest first (limit keeps the newest). Required: id. Optional: limit, text_limit (per entry).

id.description: Work package key (e.g. "AIS-469") or numeric id (e.g. 17806).

tools.name: pm_list_work_package_activity

tools.description: List a work package's relations (blocks, precedes, relates to, ...). Required: id.

id.description: Work package key (e.g. "AIS-469") or numeric id (e.g. 17806).

tools.name: pm_list_work_package_relations

tools.description: Relate two work packages (id → related_to_id). An existing pair is returned with already_exists=true.

id.description: Work package key (e.g. "AIS-469") or numeric id (e.g. 17806).

related_to_id.description: Work package key (e.g. "AIS-469") or numeric id (e.g. 17806).

tools.name: pm_create_work_package_relation

tools.description: Delete a relation by relation_id, or by the pair id + related_to_id (either direction).

id.description: Work package key (e.g. "AIS-469") or numeric id (e.g. 17806).

related_to_id.description: Work package key (e.g. "AIS-469") or numeric id (e.g. 17806).

tools.name: pm_delete_work_package_relation

tools.description: List boards (optionally of one project, search by name); pass the id to pm_get_board.

project.description: Project identifier (e.g. "AIS"), name or numeric id; a key like "AIS-499" names its project.

tools.name: pm_list_boards

tools.description: List meetings, optionally by project, date range (from/to, YYYY-MM-DD) and state.

tools.description: List logged time entries (hours as decimal). Without project it covers every project the user can read — for a day/week overview call it ONCE with spent_on_from/spent_on_to and group_by, never per project. group_by returns total_hours and per-group sums instead of the entries.

project.description: Project identifier (e.g. "AIS"), name or numeric id; a key like "AIS-499" names its project.

work_package_id.description: Work package key (e.g. "AIS-469") or numeric id (e.g. 17806).

project.description: Project identifier (e.g. "AIS"), name or numeric id; a key like "AIS-499" names its project.

user.description: On behalf of this user (id, login, "me").

work_package_id.description: Work package key (e.g. "AIS-469") or numeric id (e.g. 17806).
